verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs show it tracks which comments remain unaddressed or unresolved across iterations (MCP fetch of unaddressed feedback, `/greploop` iterating until zero unresolved comments). They also mention configurable review triggers and noise control that skips repetitive feedback, which together imply re-review that tracks fixes. However, no evidence explicitly states that pushing new commits automatically triggers an incremental, diff-scoped re-review that marks prior issues as fixed rather than re-posting them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of commit-push-triggered incremental re-review, explicit resolved/fixed tracking of prior comments on re-review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
